title: Guild Bounty Board
description: Vorn keeps a running list nailed by the door - names, gold, and how dead he needs something. Take one, finish it, get paid. No ceremony.

objectives.description: Finish the job on the board

notes: REPEATABLE. Available after Champion rank. Bounty targets rotate weekly. Includes: bandit leaders, monster dens, escort missions, dungeon clearing. Rewards scale with target difficulty. Can complete unlimited times. Works with BountyManager system. This is a system wrapper by design and deliberately carries no plot per the batch brief - only Vorn's voice, no invented stake.
